name: tryaii
description: TryAii plugins for Claude Code: connect your Claude Code usage to TryAii and get plain-language cost reports.

plugins.name: tryaii
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to TryAii in one step (/tryaii:tryaii-connect) and get a 30-day cost report (/tryaii:tryaii-report). A session-end hook adds project, subagent type and task advice to live calls (tryaii claude-code sync). Metadata only; prompts and code never leave your machine.
